summary.intent: Use the GSD manager dashboard to discuss, plan, and begin executing all 5 remaining v1.1 hardening phases (51-55) in parallel using background agents and git worktrees for isolation.
summary.outcome: All 5 phases discussed and planned (21 total plans); Phase 51 fully executed (4 plans, all suites green), secured (15/15 threats closed), validated (Nyquist-compliant), and simplified (1 cleanup applied); phases 52/53/54 planned and ready to execute; Phase 55 execution intentionally deferred.

repo: GSD init.manager dep-parser misreads 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as deps=[49, '1.1'], creating a phantom dep and making the recommendations engine return nothing for phases 51-55 despite them being unblocked
Phase 50's is_active:true flag was stale in the query — it was already complete per ROADMAP; the GSD state machine can produce false-active readings for phases completed via direct ROADMAP edits

cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse does not compile cipherbox-desktop; cross-crate type changes (e.g. unwrap_key return type) can break consumer crates silently — discovered at ship-time verify, not during execution

The #683 auto-degrade fires when worktree HEAD has diverged from origin/HEAD, causing execute-phase to run plans sequentially in the current tree rather than creating nested per-plan sub-worktrees — this is actually the desired behavior for worktree-based isolation
use_worktrees:true config would create nested sub-worktrees inside the phase worktree (lacking node_modules); the auto-degrade sidesteps this, but the config interaction is a latent footgun
core.hooksPath is an absolute path to .husky in the main tree, so all worktrees share the same pre-commit hook and need node_modules for pnpm lint-staged to pass
Dependabot github-actions ecosystem block already exists in the repo — Phase 53's D-03 was pre-satisfied (verify-only, no duplicate needed)
Native cargo-workspace Cargo.lock updater has a known upstream bug (#2517); fallback is cargo update --precise + git diff --exit-code guard
Only 3 stale release-as pins exist (packages/core, packages/crypto, crates/core) — not ~8 as the Phase 53 todo estimated
fuse_abi.rs dead-code warnings are from the vendored fuser library and surface whenever cargo build runs in a new worktree — pre-existing, not caused by phase changes
Phase 55 (lib.rs 6-module decomposition) must wait until phases 51+52 merge to main; executing a file-split refactor before functional changes to the same file merge creates an unrebased nightmare

The GSD commit helper auto-switches the current tree from main to feat/<slug> on the first phase commit — running two phase discussions in the same tree without worktrees would cause branch collisions

code.finding: Type mismatch E0308 after Phase 51-03 changed unwrap_key to return Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>; fixed with .to_vec() at the storage boundary — the Zeroizing temporary still wipes on drop, the SDK-state field (long-lived) stays plain Vec<u8>
Three byte-identical base64 decode-and-map-err blocks in the S2 fail-closed verification; collapsed to a local closure in the simplify pass
Was importing createIpnsRecord/marshalIpnsRecord from @cipherbox/crypto dist; they actually live in @cipherbox/core — caught during Phase 54 planning as a D-02 contract-drift bug, fixed in plan 54-03

workflow: Background agents spawned via Agent(run_in_background=true) in this Claude Code session DO support nested Agent tool calls — the manager workflow's 'no nesting in background on Claude Code' guardrail is stale/conservative; general-purpose and claude subagent types get Tools:* including Agent

The correct worktree isolation pattern: commit phase context on the feat branch, return main tree to main, then create worktree from the feat branch — this lets the next phase auto-branch cleanly off main without collisions
pnpm i in a fresh worktree is cleaner than symlinking node_modules — gives isolated deps with no shared-tree leak risk, and hooks work correctly
Stopping a planner agent mid-run is safe when it has made no commits; the next restart begins from scratch with no stale state

The verify step (not just execution) is where cross-crate type regressions surface — running cargo check --workspace at verify caught a build break that cargo test -p <specific-crate> missed during execution

The GSD plan-checker's doc-marker hygiene findings (RESEARCH Open Questions lacking RESOLVED suffix, VALIDATION.md nyquist_compliant:false) are cosmetic and fixable inline without a revision-loop iteration — the checker can direct fixes directly

friction: Hit a session/usage rate limit mid-run that killed the Phase 51 planner after only 8 tool calls; had to restart at the reset time (8:40pm Berlin)
Phase 51 planner was initially launched without worktree isolation (Agent without isolation:'worktree'), requiring a TaskStop, manual worktree setup, and restart
GSD dep-parser bug with 'Phase N (version-string)' syntax blocked the recommendations engine, requiring manual inspection of roadmap phase statuses to identify what was actionable
Phase 50 stale is_active:true flag in init.manager output required manual cross-checking against ROADMAP to confirm it was actually complete

The execute-phase cargo test gate (cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse) did not compile the desktop crate, allowing a cross-crate type mismatch to ship undetected until the verify step — a real build break that required a hotfix commit before the ship loop could proceed
GSD commit helper false-negative on commit success required a git log check to confirm the commit actually landed
Worktree pnpm i setup adds ~1-2 minutes of latency before a planner can actually start research — multiplied across 5 worktrees
open_items: Phase 51 ship loop not yet complete — simplify was step 4/6; steps 5 (ship/PR) and 6 (CodeRabbit resolve-pr-reviews) still pending
Phases 52, 53, 54 fully planned and ready to execute; execution deferred to next session
Phase 55 execution must be replanned against the merged lib.rs after phases 51 and 52 land on main to avoid a brutal rebase of the 6-module decomposition

Desktop SDK-state fields root_folder_key and root_ipns_private_key are plain Vec<u8> — candidate for a future Zeroizing parity pass (flagged in 51-SECURITY.md informational note, out of Phase 51 scope)
Folder-key cache in FUSE inode.rs stores un-zeroized Vec<u8> — genuine S3 gap surfaced during simplify review, but deferred as a follow-up (not safe to change in the ship-prep window)
Todo #15 (logger redaction + Faro transport wiring) dropped from Phase 51 and deferred to a future observability phase; ROADMAP.md and REQUIREMENTS.md HARD-02 updated accordingly
GSD init.manager dep-parser bug with parenthesized annotations in phase names (e.g. 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)') should be fixed upstream to prevent phantom dep injection
